svg.title: Technology stack as a database schema
svg.desc: Skills drawn as an entity-relationship diagram. frontend: HTML (practiced), CSS (practiced), JavaScript (practiced), Responsive design (practiced), React (learning). backend: Python (practiced), FastAPI (learning), REST APIs (practiced), JWT authentication (learning). data: SQL (practiced), PostgreSQL (practiced), SQL Server (practiced), ER diagrams (practiced), Normalization (practiced), Alembic migrations (learning). fundamentals: C++ (practiced), C# (practiced), Object-oriented (OOP) (practiced), Data structures & algorithms (studied). erp: Odoo (learning), Python modules (learning), ORM concepts (studied), ERP workflows (studied). tools: Git (practiced), GitHub (practiced), Linux (practiced), VS Code (practiced), Visual Studio (practiced), npm (practiced).
svg.text: The stack, modelled as a schema
Status describes hands-on exposure, not expertise: practiced = used in coursework or projects · learning = actively learning now · studied = covered in theory.
